data.name: Usage
data.value:
washi {0} - open-source PDF toolkit (pre-alpha)
usage: washi --version washi masume detect <in.pdf> [-o out] suggest form fields -> fields.json + overlay PNGs washi masume eval <in.pdf> [-o out] score detection against the PDF's existing fields washi form make <in.pdf> [-o out.pdf] [--fields fields.json] [--lang auto|ja|zh-Hans|zh-Hant|ko|en|fr|de] make a fillable PDF (fields are detected unless --fields is given) --embed-font <font.ttf|.otf|.ttc> [--font-index n]: embed a whole font so rare characters show in every viewer (adds the font size to the file)
The interface follows your system language. Set WASHI_LANG (e.g. ja, ko, fr) to change it.

data.name: PrefilledNote
data.value: {0} fields already contain printed data (red dashed outline in the overlay)

data.name: EvalRecall
data.value: recall {0}/{1} = {2:P0} (real fields covered by a detection)

data.name: EvalPrecision
data.value: precision {0}/{1} = {2:P0} (detections that sit on a real field)

data.name: LangFromSystem
data.value: from your system language (the page text was unreadable)

data.name: PagesStraightened
data.value: {0} rotated page(s) straightened so the fields stay upright

data.name: ProtectedPdf
data.value: {0} is protected against changes (it needs the owner password). Washi does not remove protection: ask the author for an unprotected copy.

data.name: FontEmbedded
data.value: embedded font {0} ({1} MB): every viewer can show all of its characters

data.name: FontNotAllowed
data.value: The licence of {0} does not allow embedding it in a PDF people can edit (OS/2 fsType {1}). Choose another font.

data.name: FontNotSupported
data.value: {0} cannot be embedded: variable fonts and files that are not TrueType/OpenType fonts are not supported. Use a static .ttf, .otf or .ttc.

data.name: UnknownLanguage
data.value: Unknown form language '{0}'. Use one of: auto, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ko, en, fr, de

data.name: Ui_NoSelection
data.value: Select a field on the page or in the list.

data.name: Ui_Hint
data.value: Drag a field to move it, its corner to resize it. Delete removes it, arrow keys nudge it.

data.name: Ui_DrawHint
data.value: Drag on the page to draw a new field.

data.name: UsageAi
data.value: AI (Claude by default; data is shown and confirmed before it is sent): washi ai config [anthropic|openai|deepseek|local <model> [--endpoint url] [--vision yes|no]] washi ai key <anthropic|openai|deepseek> store an API key in the macOS Keychain washi ai models list the models the provider offers washi ai name-fields <in.pdf> [--fields f.json] [-o out.json] [--yes] washi ai fill <fillable.pdf> --profile me.txt [-o out.pdf] [--embed-font f] [--yes] washi ai ask <in.pdf> "question" [--yes]

data.name: Ai_KeyPrompt
data.value: Paste the {0} API key (it is not shown):

data.name: Ai_KeyStored
data.value: Stored in the macOS Keychain (service "washi", account "{0}").

data.name: Ai_Local
data.value: Local model {0}: nothing leaves this computer.

data.name: Ai_NeedYes
data.value: Nothing was sent: add --yes to confirm when there is no terminal to ask.

data.name: Ai_NoProfile
data.value: --profile <file> is required: a text or JSON file with the data to fill in.

data.name: Ui_PrefilledDrawn
data.value: Something is printed here (drawn as graphics, not as text). The button below reads it and makes it an editable value.

data.name: Ui_PrefilledUnreadable
data.value: Text is printed here, but the PDF's text layer cannot be read (its fonts have no Unicode mapping). The button below reads it by OCR and makes it an editable value.

data.name: UsagePdf
data.value: Pages and OCR: washi pdf merge <a.pdf> <b.pdf> ... -o out.pdf join files (form fields are kept) washi pdf split <in.pdf> [--pages 1-3,5|each] [-o dir] washi ocr <in.pdf> [-o out.pdf] [--engine auto|vision|tesseract|ai] [--lang ja,en] [--pages 1-3] [--force] [--text out.txt] [--yes] make scanned pages searchable (an invisible text layer; the page image is unchanged) washi pdf erase <in.pdf> --box page:x0,y0,x1,y1 [--box ...] [-o out.pdf] [--all-ink] [--rules] remove printed text/images under boxes for real (points, top-left origin; coloured form printing stays)

data.name: Pdf_Erased
data.value: Saved {0}: removed {1} text run(s), {2} image(s), {3} drawing(s). Check: {4} character(s) left in the erased areas, {5} pixel(s) changed elsewhere.

data.name: Pdf_Merged
data.value: {0} file(s) merged into {1}: {2} page(s), {3} form field(s)

data.name: Ocr_Nothing
data.value: No page needs OCR: every page already has text or a Washi text layer (use --force to recognise pages with text anyway).

data.name: Ocr_MissingLangs
data.value: tesseract: these languages are not installed and were skipped: {0} (macOS: brew install tesseract-lang)

data.name: Ui_LanguageNote
data.value: The window reopens in the new language; an open document stays open.

data.name: Ui_AiModelNote
data.value: The model behind the assistant, field naming, form filling and AI OCR. API keys are kept in the macOS Keychain, never in a file.

data.name: Ui_Tagline
data.value: Open-source PDF toolkit for desktop, command line and AI agents: fillable forms, OCR, combine and split, built-in AI and an MCP server.

data.name: Ui_LicenseText
data.value: Washi is free software: you may use, study, share and change it. If you share a changed version, or run it for others over a network, you must offer its source code under the same license.

data.name: Ui_ThirdPartyNote
data.value: Washi is built on these projects, each under its own license. Thank you to their authors.

data.name: Ui_PreviewHint
data.value: Click a field to type, a box to tick it. Tab moves on, Delete clears. What you type is saved into the PDF you make.

data.name: Ui_FormLead
data.value: Washi finds the boxes to fill in. Check them, fix what is wrong, then save a fillable PDF.

data.name: Ui_EditKeys
data.value: V select · F draw a field · P preview · Tab next field · Enter rename · Delete remove · arrows nudge (Shift: 5 pt)

data.name: Ui_EmbedFontNote
data.value: Optional. Embeds a whole font so rare characters (e.g. 燁) show in every viewer.

data.name: Ui_DropLead
data.value: Drop a PDF here, or choose one. Then pick a tool on the left.

data.name: Ui_OcrLead
data.value: Recognises the text of scanned pages and adds it as an invisible layer. The pages look the same.

data.name: Ui_OcrNothing
data.value: Every page already has text, so nothing needs OCR. Tick the box below to recognise them anyway.

data.name: Ui_OcrEngineNote
data.value: Apple Vision and Tesseract run on this computer. The AI model reads handwriting best, but asks before it sends pages.

data.name: Ui_OcrForce
data.value: Also pages that already have text

data.name: Ui_CombineLead
data.value: Puts PDFs together in the order below. Form fields stay fillable.

data.name: Ui_CombineEmpty
data.value: Add two or more PDFs, or drop them here.

data.name: Ui_ProtectedNote
data.value: {0} is protected: its permissions forbid reusing its pages. Washi does not remove protection.

data.name: Ui_SplitLead
data.value: Writes one PDF per page range into a folder. Form fields stay fillable.

data.name: Ui_RangesHint
data.value: For example 1-3, 5. Leave empty for one file per page.

data.name: Ui_AiEndpointNote
data.value: Leave empty for the provider's own API. A local server (Ollama, LM Studio) keeps everything on this Mac.

data.name: Ui_AiBadEndpoint
data.value: The endpoint is not a valid URL.

data.name: Ui_AiKeyWatermark
data.value: Paste a new key to replace the stored one

data.name: Ui_AiKeyFromEnv
data.value: Key from the environment variable {0} (it wins over the Keychain).

data.name: Ui_AiKeyOptional
data.value: No key stored (a local server usually needs none).

data.name: Ui_AiKeyMissing
data.value: No key yet: paste one above and save.

data.name: Ui_AiVision
data.value: Send page images (turn off for text-only models)

data.name: Ui_AccessNote
data.value: The assistant and MCP clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, …) only reach PDFs inside these folders. They create new files and never overwrite.

data.name: Ui_AccessOpenDocument
data.value: Also the folder of the PDF open in Washi

data.name: Ui_WritesNote
data.value: Approvals appear in the assistant chat, or as a card over the page for MCP clients. An unanswered request is declined after 2 minutes.

data.name: Ui_McpNote
data.value: Lets AI agents use Washi's PDF tools, the folders above and the document open here, while Washi runs. HTTP listens on 127.0.0.1 only and needs the token.

data.name: Ui_McpTokenNote
data.value: A new token locks out every HTTP client until you set it up again. washi-mcp (Claude Desktop) needs no token.

data.name: Mcp_ErrInstance
data.value: Another Washi already serves MCP ({0}). Quit it, or turn its MCP server off.

data.name: Mcp_ErrStart
data.value: The MCP server could not start: {0}

data.name: Ui_AssistantEmpty
data.value: Ask about the open PDF, or have the assistant fill, merge, split or OCR PDFs in your folders. It uses the same tools as MCP clients and asks before it writes.

data.name: Ui_AssistantWatermark
data.value: Message (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)

data.name: Ui_AssistantDocChipTip
data.value: Tell the assistant which document is open (click to leave it out)

data.name: Ui_AssistantNotice
data.value: Your messages, and the document text and page images the assistant reads with its tools, are sent to {0} ({1}). Credentials in messages (keys, passwords, tokens) are masked.

data.name: Ui_AssistantMaxTokens
data.value: The answer was cut off (output limit).

data.name: Ui_AssistantStepLimit
data.value: Stopped after too many tool steps; ask again to continue.

data.name: Ui_EraseLead
data.value: Drag boxes over what is already printed on the page, for example wrong data on a form. Washi deletes it from the PDF for real; nothing is just covered.

data.name: Ui_EraseNoBoxes
data.value: Drag on the page to draw a box.

data.name: Ui_ErasePlan
data.value: Will remove {0} text run(s), {1} image(s), {2} drawing(s).

data.name: Ui_EraseKeepColoredNote
data.value: Official forms print the form in colour and the data in black: only black and grey ink is erased.

data.name: Ui_EraseRules
data.value: Also erase thin lines (table rules, box dividers)

data.name: Ui_EraseRunNote
data.value: Writes <name>_erased.pdf next to the original and opens it. The original is not changed.

data.name: Ui_Erased
data.value: Saved {0}: {1} item(s) removed; check: {2} character(s) left in the erased areas, {3} image(s) dropped from the file.

data.name: Erase_KeptRunsOutside
data.value: a line of text runs outside the box: widen the box

data.name: Erase_KeptLargeImage
data.value: a large image (a scan?) covers this area; its pixels are not changed

data.name: Erase_KeptColored
data.value: coloured printing of the form is kept (option above)

data.name: Erase_KeptClips
data.value: text that other content is clipped to is kept (erasing it would change what shows through)

data.name: Erase_KeptChained
data.value: a text run joined to the next one on its line: widen the box to include both

data.name: Ui_AiModelsLoaded
data.value: {0} models available: pick one from the list.

data.name: Ui_AiModelsNotListed
data.value: {0} models available; '{1}' is not among them.

data.name: Ui_AiModelsNone
data.value: The provider listed no models; type the model id.

data.name: Ui_AiModelsNeedKey
data.value: Add the API key to see the provider's models.

data.name: Ui_AiModelsNeedEndpoint
data.value: Enter the endpoint first, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1

data.name: Ui_MovePrintedTip
data.value: Erase what is printed in the fields and put it into the fields as values you can edit

data.name: Ui_MovePrintedNote
data.value: Washi reads what is printed in each field (OCR when the PDF's text cannot be read), puts it in as the field's value and removes the print from a copy (<name>_erased.pdf). Check the values in Preview.

data.name: Ui_MovingPrinted
data.value: Reading and erasing the printed values…

data.name: Ui_MovedPrinted
data.value: {0} field(s) now hold their printed text as editable values ({1} read by OCR: please check them). The print was erased in {2}; click a field to edit it.

data.name: Ui_EraseMakeEditable
data.value: Then put an editable field in each box

data.name: Ui_EraseMakeEditableNote
data.value: The field holds the text that was printed there (OCR when needed), so you can change it in place.

data.name: Ui_ErasedEditable
data.value: Saved {0}: {1} item(s) erased; {2} box(es) now hold an editable field with the old text. Click one to change it.
